name: After § 17
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: 17a. welcomes the G7 leaders’ statement on Ukraine of June 2026, including the commitment to (a) support the new momentum on the battlefield and its acceleration, including by considering extending to Ukraine the benefit of licenses to allow for an increase in Ukraine’s military production and (b) increase the pressure on the Russian war economy; calls for the EU and its Member States to take all necessary steps to ensure practical implementation; / 17a. welcomes the G7 Leaders’ statement on Ukraine of June 2026, including 1) support for and acceleration of the new battlefield momentum, including through considering extending to Ukraine the benefit of licences to enable an increase in Ukraine’s military production and 2) increasing the pressure on the Russian war economy; urges the EU and the Member States to take all necessary steps to ensure practical implementation;
